<p class="eyebrow">ABOUT YOUR TEACHER</p>

# Linguistic expertise, grounded in practice

I'm Des, an English teacher with a PhD in linguistics and extensive experience teaching English and communication to international learners.

My work brings together an interest in how language works and a practical focus on what people need to do with English: make themselves understood, take part in conversations, and communicate effectively in academic and professional contexts.

## My approach

::: {.principle-grid}

::: {.principle}
### Specific

We identify the features of your English that are most relevant to your goals, rather than trying to change everything at once.
:::

::: {.principle}
### Practical

We work with realistic examples, spoken interaction and the situations you want to handle more confidently.
:::

::: {.principle}
### Informed by linguistics

Understanding pronunciation and communication patterns can make practice more focused and explain why certain things happen in spoken English.
:::

:::
